summary.en: While her party was ongoing, a mysterious masked man hopped on the yacht and shot her to death with a shotgun before fleeing the scene by jumping on the boats next to it. An hour before the party, while Morishima was making preparations for the party, the mysterious masked man snucked from behind him and hit him with his shotgun's rifle butt before attaching him and gagging him inside a locker in the boat. Hyodo engaged to her only so he could pretend to be a consultant and make her invest 50 million yen into his services which only benefited himself. Anna caught wind of it and demanded retribution from Hyodo who was unable to pay her back and they broke up. To justify that he wasn't the culprit, Hyodo says he was robbing Anna's apartment at that time and that the proof is that he left his gym card "by accident" before he left.
